pagerduty-bot: [PAGER] Incident 5019 — Multi-region health degrader detected: increased 5xx + streaming drops in ap-southeast-1 & ap-northeast-1 (trigger source: regional-health-svc) :rotating_light:
infra-bot: Suggested mitigation: shift up to 40% traffic from ap-southeast-1 -> us-west-2, fallback candidate us-west-2 capacity margin = 32%
Priya (oncall): Acknowledged. Opening quick war room in 10m. Paging SREs and metrics. I9ll start with an immediate safety steer to relieve the hottest region.
Jon (SRE): I9m here. Initial look: ap-southeast-1 cpu + GPU queuing high on inference-proxy pods, plus a sharp rise in backend grpc errors. stack traces show repeated timeouts hitting model-worker on few hosts.
Zoe (metrics): Grafana panels: https://grafana.company/redwood/regions-health. Correlation: model_worker_handle_time p99 jumps, kv_cache_evictions spike, and the ap health probe latency crosses 1.5s.
Evan (network): No obvious network partition. L4 metrics normal. I9m seeing connection churn between edge LB and proxies in ap-southeast-1, but it started after increased request rate from a traffic pattern change.
Priya (oncall): Any customer-facing alerts? CS?
Jon (SRE): Support reports: 5 customer tickets from AP region for partial streaming failures and higher tail latency. No erroring payloads lost. SLO breach marginal for those tenants.
Priya (oncall): Execute safe routing change to reduce load while we triage. Use conservative step + monitor.
Jon (SRE): Running route adjust:
```
# routing CLI
redwood route adjust --from ap-southeast-1 --to us-west-2 --routes "/v1/generate,/v1/chat" --percentage 25 --step 25 --monitor 2m
```
infra-bot: Route adjustment scheduled, step=25%, monitor_window=2m
Zoe (metrics): Suggestion: regional-5xx alert is firing every 1m and causing alert storm. Recommend increase evaluation window to 4m and raise threshold to 2.5% for AP regions while we stabilize. Also add a suppression rule for known noisy disk alerts for the region.
Priya (oncall): Good call. Jon, can you patch the Prometheus rule and mute non-actionable disk alerts?
Jon (SRE): Patching now. Snippet:
```
- alert: APRegional5xx
  expr: (sum(rate(http_requests_total{region=~"ap-.*",code=~"5.."}[4m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{region=~"ap-.*"}[4m]))) * 100 > 2.5
  for: 4m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "AP regions 5xx > 2.5% over 4m"
```
Reloaded rules and applied a mute to alertset: ap-disk-warnings for 12h.
Evan (network): After the routing change, us-west-2 accepted +23% traffic and LBs are healthy. No backend capacity alarms.
Zoe (metrics): Observed immediate improvement in ap-southeast-1 5xx from 6.1% -> 2.2% after 10m. Kv_cache_hit stayed low on heavy tenants though. Adding short-lived Grafana panel overlaying kv_cache_hit, model_worker_restarts, and net_conn_drops: https://grafana.company/d/temp/ap-failover-overlay
Priya (oncall): Immediate mitigations summary: 1) partial traffic steer 25% to us-west-2, 2) muted noisy disk alerts and lengthened alert evaluation to reduce noise, 3) started targeted rollback of a recent model_worker build in ap-southeast-1 for suspect binary.
Jon (SRE): Rollback command run on canary nodes:
```
kubectl -n inference set image ds/model-worker model-worker=registry.redwood/xg-old:2.8-canary
```
Jon (SRE): Canaries show lower memory growth and no restarts since rollback. P95 latency down ~180ms.
Zoe (metrics): Propose adding composite auto-failover guard: only trigger automated failover if (5xx > 5% over 5m) AND (fallback spare capacity >= 20%). Will create a feature flag to enable for 24h.
Priya (oncall): Agree to enable conservative auto-failover for the next 24h, exclude Dedicated/Reserved customers, and require human approval for any >50% traffic moves. Evan, can you enable that in runtime?
Evan (network): Pushing runtime flag now. infra-bot: runtime_config.update regional_auto_failover={"mode":"conservative","min_spare_pct":20,"exclude_tiers":["dedicated","reserved"],"manual_threshold_pct":50}
infra-bot: Runtime config apply successful.
Priya (oncall): Customer impact note: ~5-12 minutes degradation for affected tenants during peak; 4 paid customers opened tickets, CS looped in. No request data lost.
Zoe (metrics): Post-incident alert tuning notes to add to ticket: - AP 5xx eval: 4m / 2.5% (temporary) - Composite auto-failover rule created (5% & spare>=20%) - Temporary dashboard overlay created and snapshot saved - Muted ap-disk-warnings for 12h
Jon (SRE): Created short runbook snippet in the runbooks repo for pinning heavy tenants off a region and for rollback steps. Also added a check to gating: model_worker memory growth >20% on canary will abort auto-rollouts.
Priya (oncall): Handoff: Jon, you own postmortem and the alert dashboard cleanup. ETA for draft: EOD today. I'll stay on standby for CS comms and will review the draft.
Jon (SRE): Will do. Action items created: incident-5019 in tracker with items: alert tuning, dashboard permanency, canary gating, auto-failover review, CS timeline email.
Evan (network): Also suggest we add a multi-region traffic-surge detector to warn before region overload. Adding to monitoring backlog.
Zoe (metrics): I'll schedule a follow-up with Research on model_worker build validation to include memory/regression tests in CI.
Priya (oncall): Thanks team. Marking incident resolved in PagerDuty pending two hour watch. :white_check_mark:
pagerduty-bot: Incident 5019 status changed acknowledged -> resolved at 2024-07-02T14:18:20Z
Jon (SRE): Final note: I9ll snapshot the temporary dashboard and annotate the exact timestamps for the steer + rollback for the postmortem graphs.
Priya (oncall): Good work. Closing channel but keeping monitor watch for 2h. End of thread.
